checklist.notes: Past-perfect time relationships and connected-speech awareness are both assessed, with narrative ordering and writing integrating earlier and later events.
Correction and timeline ordering externalize the time relationship before the extended account.
Controlled grammar and timeline work lead to comprehension and writing; the final weak-form choice returns to a lower-demand pronunciation check.
Task operations and writing constraints are explicit, and answer explanations identify intended cues.
The hard writing item is bounded to four sentences and follows several focused examples.
Explicit earlier-past marking and attention to reduced function words provide useful noticing for Vietnamese learners without asserting universal difficulty.
One short writing task and four objective tasks constitute a reasonable B1.1 practice block.

methods: Reviewed the exercise set and audit against the declared original project-authored policy and external-payload/media declarations.

findings.description: The set culminates at the hard writing task, then drops to a medium isolated weak-form recognition item.
findings.recommendation: Place weak-form recognition before listening or incorporate weak forms into a final spoken retelling.
